semantics.sampling_unit: each row is one OST; OST measurements are never combined
semantics.figures: one bandwidth figure per access pattern, containing every host and OST
semantics.marks: bars show OST medians, ticks show repetitions, and whiskers show min-max
semantics.media: HDD and NVMe are identified by color; each OST remains separate
semantics.versions: FIO version is listed by host; mean lines are separated by version and media
semantics.axes: OSTs are horizontal; bandwidth in MiB/s is vertical
semantics.references: mean lines summarize per-OST medians separately for each FIO version and media
